basic_details.short_information: WAPCOS intends to engage 5 Experts for conducting environmental studies as per project requirements: 2 Expert – Engineer (Environment), 1 Expert – Scientist (Forestry), 1 Expert – Scientist (Fisheries & Aquatic Ecology) and 1 Expert – Social Scientist. The remuneration shown for every post is 40000, the maximum age is 35 years and the place of work is Gurugram. Applications are made on the recruitment portal after signing in with a mobile number and OTP, and the last date is 18 November 2026; the opening date was 4 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the WAPCOS recruitment portal listing and choose the post you are eligible for.
Open the job to check its qualifications, experience and documents before applying.
Sign in with your mobile number and OTP; new applicants can create an account first.
Submit a separate application for each post you are eligible for; only one application per post is allowed.

The portal also asks applicants to read the official notice and any application format provided under Documents. Recruitment enquiries go to [email protected]. The notice names no specific documents to upload.

content_sections.heading: About WAPCOS
content_sections.text: WAPCOS is the organisation engaging these Experts, and its official website is www.wapcos.co.in . The notice describes the engagement as technical manpower for conducting environmental studies as per project requirements. The place of work for all four posts is Gurugram.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 5 vacancies in total across four posts. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 35 years for all four posts. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age, and it does not list any desirable qualification.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) – Civil Engineering; OR Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) – Civil Engineering; OR M. Tech (Environmental Engineering); OR B. Tech (Environmental Engineering)
rows.experience: Minimum 3 year's experience in conducting Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) studies for various projects including hydropower, irrigation, ports & harbour, etc.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's or PhD in Forestry; OR in Ecology; OR in Environmental Science; OR in Wildlife Science or equivalent
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years' experience in forestry, biodiversity conservation, ecosystem assessment, or environmental planning.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's or PhD in Fisheries; OR in Aquatic Ecology; OR in Zoology or equivalent
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in fisheries resource assessment, aquatic biodiversity, aquatic ecology, or related domains. Also experience in conducting EIA studies for various projects including hydropower, irrigation, ports & harbour, airports, etc.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's or PhD in Social Sciences or Equivalent
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in Ethnography, data collection for social aspects, Social Impact Assessment Studies, etc. Also experience in conducting EIA studies for various projects including hydropower, irrigation, ports & harbour, airports, etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay
content_sections.text: The portal shows a remuneration of 40000 for each of the four posts. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances, and it does not state the tenure of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the WAPCOS recruitment portal listing and choose the post you are eligible for. Open the job to check its qualifications, experience and documents before applying. Sign in with your mobile number and OTP; new applicants can create an account first. Use "Start application" to apply. Submit a separate application for each post you are eligible for; only one application per post is allowed. Apply on or before 18 November 2026. The portal also asks applicants to read the official notice and any application format provided under Documents. Recruitment enquiries go to [email protected] . The notice names no specific documents to upload.
